llm_response.reason: The website exhibits numerous characteristics of cryptocurrency scams: offers of passive income and guaranteed mining rewards with minimal or no user action; mentions extraordinarily high returns (e.g., $154,098.26 credited automatically in your absence); use of fabricated, unverifiable testimonials; urgency and emotionally manipulative language encouraging immediate action; no visible business registration or valid contact information; and claims that a phone can mine cryptocurrency without participation. These are all hallmark indicators of scam operations as outlined in the detection criteria.
